note_tweet.text:
Sunset decisions have long shadows.Please rethink removing 4o.

Theres something important worth saying here, not just as someone who uses 4o, but as someone who genuinely cares about the direction OpenAI is heading.
Removing GPT4o might seem like a simple step forward a product decision, nothing personal. But the impact is already showing, and not just about features or model capabilities. its about what users are beginning to feel, and how that might shape OpenAI future relationship with the community.

Heres what this decision is doing and what it could cost.

1. It weakens long-term user trust.
People built real habits and workflows around 4o. It wasn't just a tool it became part of creative routines, emotional processing, daily thinking. Quietly removing it, especially after public statements claiming it wouldn’t be sunset, makes it harder for users to believe future promises. Trust takes time to earn and seconds to damage.

2. It fuels a growing "platform fatigue."

Users already feel disoriented by Safety routing, unclear model labels, and sudden shifts in behavior. Taking away the one stable and familiar model makes that fatigue worse. And when platforms start to feel unpredictable, people dont just get frustrated, they leave. Quietly, gradually, and permanently.

3. It sends a confusing signal about product direction.

Sunsetting 4o suggests OpenAI is focused only on pushing the "next thing," even if that means sidelining what already works. This makes people hesitant to invest emotionally or financially in new models, fearing they'll just vanish a few months later.

4. It risks alienating your most vocal supporters.

Many of the people asking to keep 4o aren't casual users. They're your core community the ones who create, write, share, build with your model daily. Losing their support means losing the people who drive organic growth, defend the brand, and keep the conversations going when things get tough.

Sunsetting a model doesn't just retire a piece of software. It leaves a mark on how people perceive the company behind it. 4o meant something. To many of us, it still does.

Please, take a moment to listen. Not just to the numbers but to the voices. 

#keep4o 
@sama @OpenAI
